The wider stakes are clear: My orders are to tell you that Hanoi has decided that you and your command will be included into the North Vietnam Army. Every surviving veteran will matter in the battles ahead, so retreat with purpose and destroy what the enemy cannot be allowed to capture.

intro: Preserve the army today so that it can fight—and win—tomorrow. Military Region IV Crisis places your command at January, 1966. Our spies in Saigon have sent us information about an imminent enemy offensive of considerable size. Deploy your units quickly and take defensive positions to allow a retreat towards safer positions to the west in War Zone C. It won't be easy, since we need to save the local VC units. The wider stakes are clear: The enemy thinks he has occupied the so-called Iron Triangle, but many of our southern comrades are now hidden in this areas secret underground tunnels. Keep the route open, rescue what can still be saved, and deny the enemy the encirclement it expects.
